Independent MAIN validity confirms sound subfield scope below the field floor (7.3 < 7.4); positioning, priority-source verification and stale scope prose remain editorial debt. tldr: An exact finite decision theorem determines \(B_n(k)\), the power any size-\(1/20\) experiment can guarantee over all fixed binary populations with total causal effect at least \(k\). Independent fair assignment and a total transformed-count test attain a two-branch binomial value. Complete deterministic-table priors provide a matching converse against every ex ante assignment law and original-record rejection kernel. The least-favorable nuisance changes from a first-passage mixture to a maximum-width alternative. Exact rational computation, a uniform quantitative local power curve and prospective planning accompany the finite frontier. A finite linear system characterizes every attaining original procedure, an oracle lower bound rules out universal polynomial-query membership, and the all-beneficial endpoint has an explicit support phase change.
gap: Prescribed weak-null procedures and unrestricted squared-risk estimation do not evaluate the inspected effect-only size-constrained power game.
fill: An evaluated rational finite frontier, an attaining original-record rule and compatible table-prior certificates, followed by a quantitative crossover atlas and exact prospective planning.
